ingredientSections.heading: Green Rice
items: 1 Cup tightly packed fresh stemmed spinach leaves (about 45g)
2 Tbsp olive oil (or 1 Tbsp olive oil and 1 of butter)

ingredientSections.heading: Bowl Assembly
items: Garnish with fresh mint and/or cilantro

methodSections.heading: Green Rice
steps: Add the parsley, spinach and vegetable broth to a blender and blend well. Add the almond milk, lemon juice and salt and blend again until combined.

Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the rice and sautée, stirring often, until it begins to brown slightly. Add the onion and garlic and cook for another minute while stirring.

Add quinoa and then the blended broth mix, stir well, increase the heat to high and bring to a boil. Cover the saucepan, reduce the heat to a simmer, and cook for 20 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed.
Stir the rice carefully to avoid crushing it, cover and cook for another 5 minutes. Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the rice steam in the covered pot for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

methodSections.heading: Chimichurri Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients into a blender or food processor and blend until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Roasted Edamame
steps: Place the thawed edamame into a mixing bowl, drizzle with the olive oil, then sprinkle with the basil, paprika, salt and pepper to taste. Toss until the edamame are evenly coated with the oil and spices.
Spread out in a baking dish in a single layer and roast uncovered until the beans begin to brown, 12-15 minutes, stirring once halfway through.

methodSections.heading: Bowl Assembly
steps: With a peeler, slice cucumber into long strips and roll into logs.
Portion the rice into 4 serving bowls.

Place a small handful of spinach on the rice to the side of each bowl. Spoon a half cup of the roasted edamame beside the spinach along with a peeled and halved avocado (grilled if you like). Add the cucumber log rolls.
Drizzle the chimichurri sauce over top and fill a small ramekin with more sauce for dipping.
Garnish with any herbs like mint or cilantro and pumpkins seeds.
